records.text: Andrew Piscadlo, a photographer initially suspected online after the Charlie Kirk shooting, had previously warned about alleged trafficking of Ukrainian children in the United States.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Andrew Piscadlo... ended up being that he was photographing... not hired by Turning Point USA but he has rang the alarm before on military Ukrainian sex trafficking that is happening in the United States.

verification.notes: Public material confirms Piskadlo’s presence and self-description, but the reviewed archive did not preserve or substantiate the claimed Ukrainian-trafficking investigation.

sources.title: Andrew Piskadlo public posts archive
sources.relevance: Confirms his public self-identification and statements about attending the shooting scene, but not the trafficking claim.
